items.item_text: Experience in the use of custodial equipment and tools such as vacuum cleaners, powered floor polishers, industrial carpet cleaners, mops, carts, buckets, personal protective equipment, etc.

The Senior Custodian is responsible for maintaining all interior and exterior common areas at the 2120 Delaware Apartment Complex in a clean, orderly, and well-presented condition. Working to APPA Level 2 (Ordinary Tidiness) standards, this role performs advanced custodial duties, supports basic grounds maintenance, and ensures proper waste handling and disposal across the property. The position may provide informal direction to other custodial staff and serves as a key point of quality control for daily operations.
Knowledge of proper and safe use of custodial equipment, chemicals, tools, etc.
Knowledge of procedures related to building safety.
Knowledge of green cleaning practices and safety procedures for handling waste.
Skill in prioritizing workload to meet daily schedule.
Ability to effectively communicate and follow oral and written instructions, read manuals, signs, and labels.
Ability to work with minimal supervision.
Ability to maintain cleanliness in alignment with the Association of Physical Plant Administrators 2 (APPA 2).
Ability to accommodate changing priorities and complete tasks despite intermittent interruptions.
Ability to carry and operate technology, including tablets and cell phones along with the use of programs and applications.
Ability to safeguard keys issued, which are necessary for assigned areas.
Ability to incorporate the concepts of sustainability into daily work efforts.
Ability to promote the UCSC Principles of Community through collaboration, clear communication, and a focus on diversity and belonging.
Ability to adapt to change, support organizational goals and use University resources responsibly and efficiently.
